2083|43d804cc.name: Syral Bladeleaf
2083|43d804cc.text: Like Teldrassil itself, Dolanaar embraces those who embrace the land.

2481|014b9d07.name: Bliztik
2481|014b9d07.text:
A customer all the way out here? What luck! This place was a goldmine of empty alchemy bottles. Kinda weird.

Don't worry, I washed 'em out.

252477|80396915.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|80396915.text: That trainer can be found in a house near the High Order dock, on the southeastern edge of town.

254100|1ab538e5.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|1ab538e5.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is becoming a major problem and the peacekeepers seem powerless to stop them. We can only hope that the Windshapers and the High Order can put aside their bickering and work with the peacekeepers to protect us.

I certainly don't want to join a cult!

257004|eb1639bf.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|eb1639bf.text: Welcome to my shop, it's good to see another Enchanter here in Valanaar. Are you here for a lesson perhaps?

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

275350|f33c9b0b.name: Timothy Jones
275350|f33c9b0b.text: Sorry, $c. I have nothing to teach you. I'm still learning myself!

302|994abcf7.name: Blind Mary
302|994abcf7.text: The memory of my beauty makes its loss unbearable!

3136|2e231d45.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|2e231d45.text: Yeah, I've heard through the grapevine that I might be seeing you sooner or later. But I don't just take on anyone, I need to make sure you have what it takes first. You willing to take my little test and find out?

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

464|8234ebcf.name: Guard Parker
464|8234ebcf.text: Hail, $C.  Ill times these are, my friend, for our town is besieged!  The Blackrock Orcs attack from Stonewatch Keep, the Shadowhides loom over the Tower of Ilgalar, and the Redridge Gnoll Pack gathers strength.  I hope you're not here for a holiday...

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

174-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-progress.text: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
174-progress.title: Look to the Stars

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

3117-progress.name: Ayanna Everstride
3117-progress.text:
You've arrived, and none too soon, $N. Welcome to Shadowglen.

I trust my sigil found you in good spirits and health?

As I said previously, I am here to train you as a $c; to tame beasts to aid you in battle; to use a bow with unerring accuracy; to respect the lands which we call home and also the lands beyond.
3117-progress.title: Etched Sigil

34-progress.name: Martie Jainrose
34-progress.text: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
34-progress.title: An Unwelcome Guest

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

458-complete.name: Tarindrella
458-complete.text: I see you found me, young $r.  Melithar is a wise druid to have sent you. But you still have much to learn. I understand your kind enjoys books. Please take one of these to further your education.
458-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

488-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-progress.text: Have you been a busy little bee, $N?  I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.
488-progress.title: Zenn's Bidding

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

90-progress.name: Chef Grual
90-progress.text: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet?
90-progress.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

91899-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

921-progress.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-progress.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
921-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

92645-accept.name: Yorana Windyreed
92645-accept.text:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.
92645-accept.title: Breaking the Breaker

92741-progress.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-progress.text: The High Order does not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
92741-progress.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92834-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92834-progress.text: I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
92834-progress.title: Avenged Tenfold

92840-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92840-progress.text:
It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally slavish to their misplaced beliefs, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.

They see our desire to better understand this realm and its magic as a desecration of their traditions. Their small-mindedness is why our mission is so important. If not us, who will have the courage to save Zephras?
92840-progress.title: Catching Wind

92850-progress.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92850-progress.text: Those shrieklings are too dangerous to be left to nest this close to Valanaar. However... they are the least of our troubles.
92850-progress.title: The Missing Scholar

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

93791-accept.name: Belann Windwood
93791-accept.text:
$N, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.

Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.
93791-accept.title: Speak with Belann

93791-complete.name: Belann Windwood
93791-complete.text: Ah, you must be $N? It is heartening to see young mages eager to learn our ways and history. Come, I will explain the next steps to crafting your spell focus.
93791-complete.title: Speak with Belann

93797-accept.name: Belann Windwood
93797-accept.text:
It is a time-honored tradition for young mages to create their own spell focus when they have shown a certain degree of magical proficiency. This is typically done by gathering a fallen branch from our oldest trees, as they have some lingering traces of elemental wind.

I have found the most ideal ones to be near the wind shrine, just south of Falaath Village. Go and bring me back a large branch and I will teach you about the traditions as we create your spell focus.
93797-accept.title: Boughs in the Wind

93797-complete.name: Belann Windwood
93797-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. I can indeed feel the elemental energies in this bough waiting to be harnessed by those that have the gift to do so. This will make an excellent spell focus.

Did this branch sing to you, perhaps? It has often been the case that the branch picks the $c, and not the other way around.

<Belann chuckles as he gently takes the bough from you.>
93797-complete.title: Boughs in the Wind

93797-progress.name: Belann Windwood
93797-progress.text:
Every year that passes in Zephras sees fewer and fewer of those who are gifted with a talent for magic. 

I am glad to see young mages such as yourself participate in our oldest traditions to help keep our history and culture alive and well.
93797-progress.title: Boughs in the Wind

95999-accept.name: Unknown
95999-accept.text:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999-accept.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

95999-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
95999-complete.text: Excellent work, $N! Incinerator Gar'im was preparing to bolster the defenses at Stonewatch Keep. With this victory, we may yet succeed in reclaiming the keep!
95999-complete.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96138-accept.name: Unknown
96138-accept.text:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
96138-accept.title: Merrick's Bow

96139-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-accept.text:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139-accept.title: The Valor Family

96139-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-complete.text:
This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them.

I'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.
96139-complete.title: The Valor Family

96139-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139-progress.title: The Valor Family

96606-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96606-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96606-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96606-complete.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96606-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96606-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96630-accept.name: Unknown
96630-accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96630-accept.title: The Adventurer

96630-complete.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-complete.text:
Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96630-complete.title: The Adventurer

96630-progress.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96630-progress.title: The Adventurer

96634-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96634-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96634-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97236-accept.name: Unknown
97236-accept.text: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
97236-accept.title: Fang of Githyiss

97236-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
97236-complete.text:
My, my. How I do love surprises, $N.

This specimen will surely help further my studies.
97236-complete.title: Fang of Githyiss

97949-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97949-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97949-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97977-accept.name: Tarindrella
97977-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
97977-accept.title: Nature's Call

97977-complete.name: Tarindrella
97977-complete.text:
Oh, it's even worse than I thought.

These engravings tell us that the Gnarlpine began having nightmares of being wiped out by some great shadow. Before long, that fear turned to rage--and the shadow to their former elven friends. To be aware of your own mind slipping away from you...

Our only hope is that this may help us better understand what is happening on Teldrassil. Thank you for your aid, $N.
97977-complete.title: Nature's Call

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call

97979-accept.name: Shanda
97979-accept.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979-accept.title: The Goddess Provides

97979-complete.name: Shanda
97979-complete.text: You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.
97979-complete.title: The Goddess Provides

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label

98372-complete.name: Night Watch Guard
98372-complete.text:
The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.
98372-complete.title: An Unfortunate End

98387-accept.name: Marshal Marris
98387-accept.text:
You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387-accept.title: Blackrock Blockade

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

99191-progress.name: Belanaa Windveil
99191-progress.text:
The High Order are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the High Order for your generous actions.  Sixty pieces of wool should prove to be a sufficient amount for the High Order's needs for now. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99191-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
